english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the quality of being important or significant.

exampleSentences.english: Everyone understands the importance of education.
exampleSentences.traditional: 大家都明白教育嘅重要性。
exampleSentences.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 ming4 baak6 gaau3 juk6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing3

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the importance of something.

exampleSentences.english: This report makes the significance of environmental protection clear.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢份報告講清楚環保嘅重要性。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 gong2 cing1 co2 waan4 bou2 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing3

english.note: Use this for the relative importance of a person, thing, or issue.

exampleSentences.english: The report highlights the prominence of this issue.
exampleSentences.traditional: 報告特別指出呢個議題嘅重要性。
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou3 gou3 dak6 bit6 zi2 ceot1 ni1 go3 ji5 tai4 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing3

english.note: Use this when priority refers specifically to an item's relative importance, especially in expressions such as 'high priority'.

exampleSentences.english: This issue is a high priority, so it can't be delayed.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個問題嘅重要性好高，唔可以拖。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing3 hou2 gou1 m4 ho2 ji5 to1

english.note: Use this noun when matter means the degree to which something is important.

exampleSentences.english: This report emphasizes the matter of education's importance.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢份報告強調咗教育嘅重要性。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 fan6 bou3 gou3 koeng4 diu6 zo2 gaau3 juk6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing3

english.note: Use 重要性 when stating the abstract importance of something instead of the more figurative 份量.

exampleSentences.english: I understand that this matter is of great moment.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我明白呢件事嘅重要性。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing3

english.note: Use this when consideration means importance or the degree of attention something deserves.

exampleSentences.english: The importance of this report deserves further detailed consideration.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢份報告嘅重要性，值得我哋再詳細研究。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing3 zik6 dak1 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 coeng4 sai3 jin4 gau3
